name: The Tobacconist's Manual
landing_text: A complete field guide to Tobacconist for Minecraft 1.21.1. Start with Getting Started, then use the chapter categories as a full reference for growing, curing, cutting, fermentation, aging, smoking, shisha, storage, automation, and configuration.$(br2)The normal gameplay inspection tool is the Tobacconist's Spectacles; no debug command is required for ordinary play.
subtitle: Complete 1.21.1 Field Guide
